title.en: What actually differs between ICP and CCP?

subtitle.zh: 从等离子体产生、离子能量到刻蚀轮廓
subtitle.en: From plasma generation and ion energy to etch profiles

body.zh: 说明：比较耦合方式，不比较谁更高级
body.en: Note: compare coupling methods, Not which is more advanced

body.zh: ICP高密度等离子体独立Bias晶圆台
body.en: ICP High-density plasma Independent-Bias wafer stage

body.zh: 说明：线圈造Plasma，Bias调离子入射
body.en: Note: the coil generates Plasma, Bias adjusts ion incidence

body.zh: 线圈产生等离子体Bias控制离子入射
body.en: The coil generates plasma Bias controls ion incidence

body.zh: 说明：电极、鞘层与自偏压共同控制放电
body.en: Note: electrodes, sheaths and self-bias Jointly control the discharge

body.zh: 上下电极形成鞘层自偏压驱动离子入射
body.en: Upper and lower electrodes form sheaths Self-bias drives ion incidence

body.zh: 说明：Ion Flux和Ion Energy不是同一指标
body.en: Note: Ion Flux and Ion Energy Are not the same metric

body.zh: 通量与能量需分别判断，且仍存在耦合
body.en: Flux and energy require separate assessment, And coupling still exists

body.zh: 说明：功率之外还有压力、气体、频率和温度
body.en: Note: beyond power, there are pressure, Gas, frequency and temperature

body.zh: 功率Plasma温度压力频率气体
body.en: Power Plasma Temperature Pressure Frequency Gas

body.zh: 多维工艺参数共同影响等离子体与离子特性
body.en: Multiple process parameters jointly affect Plasma and ion properties

body.zh: 说明：离子管方向，自由基管化学
body.en: Note: ions govern direction, Radicals govern chemistry

body.zh: 物理决定方向性化学决定选择性
body.en: Physics determines directionality Chemistry determines selectivity

body.zh: 说明：材料和结构决定平台，不按高低级选
body.en: Note: materials and structures determine the platform, Not a hierarchy of sophistication
Material and structure to be etched

body.zh: 结合需求匹配平台不存在固定答案
body.en: Match the platform to the requirements There is no fixed answer

body.zh: 说明：同一种异常可能来自不同物理机制
body.en: Note: the same anomaly can Arise from different physical mechanisms

body.zh: Bowing（弯曲）离子能量分布中性粒子角度侧壁钝化不足
body.en: Bowing (bowing) Ion-energy distribution Neutral-particle angle Insufficient sidewall passivation

body.zh: Microtrench（微沟槽）非均匀保护层局部电场增强反应物供给差异
body.en: Microtrench (microtrench) Nonuniform protective layer Local electric-field enhancement Differences in reactant supply

body.zh: Notching（下切）底部电场增强离子汇聚中性粒子阴影
body.en: Notching (undercut) Bottom electric-field enhancement Ion focusing Neutral-particle shadowing

body.zh: 现象相似 ≠ 机制相同定位根因再优化
body.en: Similar phenomena ≠ identical mechanisms Find the root cause before optimizing

body.zh: 说明：看工艺输出，不只看设备标签
body.en: Note: examine process output, Not just equipment labels

body.zh: 以工艺输出为依据形成闭环持续改进
body.en: Use process output as the basis For continuous closed-loop improvement
